title: Bible-Corpus, Czech Collection — Czech Bible text (Kralice translation) from the Multilingual Parallel Bible Corpus
notes: The 66 books of the Czech Bible in the Multilingual Parallel Bible Corpus (Christos Christodoulopoulos), now hosted in the TextGrid Repository (TEI P5) and formerly on GitHub (CES XML, CC0-1.0). The text is the Kralice Bible wording in modernised spelling taken from the Bible Database, so 1613 is the date of the translation, not of a diplomatic transcription. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Christos Christodoulopoulos; hosted in the TextGrid Repository
